items.author: therunepony.bsky.social
items.context: Is there an equivalent of ProtonDB for GOG games?
items.text: ProtonDB is built around Steam games, so GOG coverage is thin there. Most GOG games come with a plain Windows installer, so a quick search of the game's name plus "Linux" usually turns up other players' notes.
items.verify: Проверить: у ProtonDB в основном игры Steam, а у GOG нет прямого аналога с рейтингами.

items.author: 04badmoviescene.bsky.social
items.context: I want to play a computer game but I don't want to have to install a whole goddamn steam deck (?) to play like. Unpacking. do you feel me. are there any good in-browser clicky draggy solution games that give you a sense of accomplishment?
items.text: Itch.io has a lot of free puzzle games that run right in the browser, no install. Its game search has a filter for browser-playable games, and searching for "tidy" or "sorting" gets close to that Unpacking feeling.
items.verify: Проверить: на itch.io есть фильтр игр, которые играются в браузере (Play in browser).

items.text: Nice pickup at that price. Dying Light plays great on PC with mouse and keyboard, and the parkour is much smoother once you get the rhythm.
